gap: BHD IS CLEAN, so this is a design verdict, not leakage. Against baseline-*.png with the BHD key forced the raw counts are large (customer 303,503/5,184,000; invoice 938,349; dashboard 1,686,720; dashboard-390 516,902/1,316,640) but those baselines are stale DATA: they show 6 clients (Bluepeak Consulting, Aster Foods, Lumen Interiors) in UAE/Canada/Singapore/Kenya/Netherlands/Portugal under company 'Meridian Supply Group' / user 'Sam', versus today's 10 Oman clients under 'COMPANY Name' / 'Wave', and baseline-invoice-list-empty had zero rows where /invoice now has 10. The decisive same-session A/B is BHD forced at document-start with the wave stylesheet present vs removed: 0 differing px on /invoice and /customer at BOTH viewports (5,184,000 and 1,316,640 px each), and 198 px on the dashboard confined to one 25x17 box at (2574,202) which crops to 'lated: 02:29' vs '02:30' - a clock. Scoping holds. THE DESIGN: /customer at 1440 genuinely beats Wave (dead-even 72px rows, pale #f1f4f9 non-uppercase header, 13px/600 #101828 labels, hairline #e8edf5 separators, no vertical rules, no zebra, one white container, bold near-black name) and every structural defect from r2-r4 on /invoice is fixed: row heights 72px x10 with 0.0 spread (was a 1.86x swing), ant-table-ping-right false, no clipped Payment column, no white strip, no raw Evidence_incomplete enum. But the money screen is still louder than the bar in four ways. (1) A six-card KPI strip sits above the table in FIVE hues - red Unpaid, green Paid, purple Partially Paid, amber Evidence Incomplete, red Overdue, slate Draft - and five of the six read 0/10 or 0.00%; it eats ~300px above the fold at 1440 and the ENTIRE first screen at 390 before one row is visible. _shell.css sections 4b/4c strip exactly this defect (inline gradients, border-left stripes, six hues) inside .wave-dash-frame on the dashboard; the list page was left alone, so the builder's own documented fix does not reach the screen that decides this piece. Wave's Transactions holds one blue and one dark. (2) 'Evidence Incomplete' fires in amber with a warning triangle on 10 of 10 rows, with an amber KPI card reading 100.00% beside it - flagged in r2, r3 and r4, and r6 only fixed the casing. A column carrying one identical value on every row, set in alarm amber with an icon, is the inverse of a bar whose rows are silent and which puts its one 'Choose a category' prompt on the single row that needs it. (3) The Client cell hard-clips mid-word with NO ellipsis: 'Al Manara Integrated Facilities Management L'. Measured cause - the td computes text-overflow:ellipsis but the inner SPAN that actually overflows (scrollWidth 328 vs clientWidth 309) computes text-overflow:clip, so 19px is cut and the ellipsis never renders. The same string sets in full on /customer at 481px. (4) At 390 neither list is a financial table: /invoice becomes bhd-mobile-cards, /customer collapses to name + kebab and drops Contact, Type, Location and Last Activity entirely, and a fixed 56px z-1050 'AI Assistant (locked)' FAB at right:16px sits ON the stack - measured, it overlaps the top invoice card's Client value by 14px on BOTH wrapped lines, and on /customer it covers two of the three dots of the last row's kebab. A padlocked, unusable feature floating over the primary field of the money list, identical to the FAB occlusion r4 reported. Minor: two adjacent /invoice controls both placeholder 'search' (an input and a select). Not counted against it: the bottom-right island is the TanStack Query devtools button, dev-only. Fix the three row-level ones (gate the amber badge on real state, put text-overflow:ellipsis on the SPAN not just the td, move or hide the locked FAB off the list scroll area) and de-hue the KPI strip to the bar's one-blue rule, and this wins.
